title: Health Insurance Administration (Civil Health Insurance) — contracted private hospitals, dialysis units and dental centres
publisher: Health Insurance Administration, Ministry of Health (إدارة التأمين الصحي)
notes: Four PDFs from the HIA 'contracted private hospitals' page. f2 = grade-1 government employees, admission + emergency, updated 2026-09-30 (48 rows; row numbering skips 27 in the source). f3 = grades 2 & 3, emergency department only (insured pays 20% of the ER bill), updated 2026-09-13. f1 = dialysis: page 1 'rented' dialysis units 2026, page 2 contracted dialysis units 2026; f1 is a scanned image and was transcribed by hand from the page images (names only, as printed, often without the word 'مستشفى'). f4 = dental centres/clinics contracted for senior grades, updated 2026-03-30; parsed by column position, multi-line cells joined. Arabic text was extracted in visual order and re-ordered (lam-alef ligatures fixed); tatweel removed. Names are as printed (f2 omits 'مستشفى'); the same hospital appears in several lists — one record per list row, dedupe downstream. No English names in the source. Phones as printed (spaces removed).
